full_judgment: Mohammad Abdur Rouf, J:- This petition for leave to appeal, by the defendants, is from the Judgment and order dated 11.5.92 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1916 of 1981 making the Rule absolute and decreeing the suit after setting aside the judgment and decree dated 6.7.81 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Jhenidah in Title Appeal No. 22 of. 1980 dismissing the suit on reversal of the judgment and decree dated 11.5.79 passed by the learned Munsif, 2nd Court, Jhenidah in Title Suit no 407 of 1973 decreeing the suit.
